$Comment: The Hardcore Vigil daily's own payout table, standalone (no other mod required): a rare
essence bundle (a couple of the Concentrated variant on top of a plain handful) plus the
strongest of the three XP boost tokens, matching the ALL/2.0/30 token this pack's own
Proving Day quest already pays out.
Ingredient_Life_Essence_Concentrated is a Rare-quality vanilla reagent (100 plain essence
condense into 1), so a couple of these read as a genuine prize for the hardest preset. Retune
the Counts or the token's Multiplier/DurationMinutes freely; see
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/RewardKinds/Mmo_Boost_Token.json for the token's full Params reference.
